notes: The single-player battle panels in 640x480 units, from the original's records: game_quest_tex (slot 465, sprites 1397-1434) for the panels, game_tex (slot 464) for the weapon digits and common_2d_tex/1 for the labels and the number font. Split screen uses battle_panels_split2.json (two screens) and battle_panels_split4.json (three or four) instead: game_vs_tex (slot 466) and the records at 0x204148, 0x203f50, 0x204a20, 0x205100 and 0x204d90.
layout: "widescreen" keeps left- and right-anchored elements to the window's edges; "4:3" leaves every element where the original puts it (docs/WIDESCREEN.md). Anchors are the port's.
flash_frames: the original's colour flash (0x4dc2f) runs over 10 frames; see hud_flash in battle_hud_state.hpp.

durability (0x4aaed, records 0x203dac and 0x203d90): the DURABILITY frame 1399 and the fill 1398 stretched to width * armour / maximum, 0xffffc823, 0xffc04040 below low; it flashes toward flash_colour while the shown value is under the robot's (+0x50 < +0x44). The shown armour eases from where it stood to each new armour (0x076368) over the change's share of the maximum times 90 frames, or 300 frames for a change under a tenth, at 60 frames a second (0x075773): a hit drains the gauge and a repair fills it, flashing (port/include/phantomcrash/shown_armour.hpp).

optic (0x4aaed, records 0x203d74 and 0x203d58): the O.C TIME frame 1401 and the fill 1400 stretched to width * the Optic Camouflage gauge (0x753c2 on robot +0x3494), 0xff3f77c1, 0xffc040c0 below low; while recovering (states 9 and 10), not while camouflaged, it flashes between active_colour and colour.

weapons (0x4ad3b, records 0x204340 left and 0x2046b0 right, 0x28 bytes each): weapon slots 0 and 2 (right arm, right shoulder) use the right side, 1 and 3 the left; the arm's panel sits at arm, the shoulder's at shoulder. The frame (1430 left, 1431 right) and the weapon's icon are ready_colour, flashing toward refill_colour while a refill counts the shown ammunition up (weapon +0x98 below +0x94, over 120 frames). A lost weapon shows WEAPON LOST (1413, 1414, 0xffff4040) instead of its icon.

icons are keyed by the weapon's kind (weapon record +0x1c, tables/parts.json): 0 cannon -> 1421/1422, 1 missile -> 1417/1418, or homing (1415/1416) when the record's homing rate (+0x40) is not zero, 2 machine gun or shotgun -> 1423/1424, 3 grenade -> 1419/1420, 5 beam -> 1425/1426, 6 melee -> 1427/1428. readout is what the panel shows beside the icon.

readout "ammo" (kinds 0-3): the shown ammunition in four zero-padded digits at digit_positions (12, 24, 36, 48 left / 31, 43, 55, 67 right) and the bar 1429 stretched to bar_width * shown / maximum (mirrored on the right), bar_colour, bar_low_colour below bar_low, flashing toward refill_colour while refilling. readout "charge" (kind 5): three digits of the percentage at the first three digit_positions, the percent sign (1354, 1375) and the bar, flashing toward bar_charging_colour until full. readout "none" (kind 6): the icon only.

labels (0x4ad3b, records 0x203e70-0x203ec4, number font 3 at 0x27dc18 + 3 * 64, 0xfff0f0f0): DAY- (3751) at 396,39 (the record's 356 plus 40) and the day plus one in two zero-padded digits ending at 453; TIME (3757) at 466,39 and the battle clock (battle +0xee524, one a 60 Hz frame) as HH:MM:SS written from 504, the colon (3746) advancing colon_advance, ending at 586; MONEY (3753) at 421,430 and the money in nine digits with commas ending at 573; SHOOTDOWN (3756) at 47,430 and the player's kills (robot +0x20) in four zero-padded digits ending at 187. Each number is placed from its label's left, the label's width and the digit advance (0xd381c).

messages (0x4ad3b, HUD state + 0x8b4; 0x4da6c queues them): DAMAGED (1403, 0xffc8dc50), HIT (1404, 0xff0fc8d2) and BINGO! (1402, 0xfffaf000) at 48,388, each 120 frames, sliding in from 30 below over 10 frames and out toward 150 above; the list drops push_scroll when one arrives and rises scroll_decay of that a frame, at least min_scroll. DAMAGED is queued when the player takes damage; HIT goes to a robot whose hit did damage to another (0x9d2ce); when a robot is shot down (0x7675e) it gets DAMAGED if others had damaged it, and every robot that damaged it gets BINGO! and a kill.

warning (0x4ad3b, records 0x203de4-0x203e54): below half armour the stripes 1412 and SYS DURABILITY DOWN 50% (1408); below a quarter the stripes and 75% (1410), at 431,73. Their lettering is two lines 14 pixels apart, 12 high (line_pitch); the sharp text keeps that size rather than filling the 152x40 sprite. The original alternates two records every 60 frames; the European records are the same text twice (the Japanese sprites 1409 and 1411 are unused).
missile_alert (0x4ad3b, record 0x203dc8): MISSILE ALERT (1406, 0xffff8080) at 248,120 while a missile is homing on the player, its alpha 0.5 + 0.5 * a 60-frame triangle wave.
